name: card
title: Card
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Card as a comic panel: 3px frame and an offset screentone shadow. Variants: default, bleed (first image runs to the edges), tilted (slanted bottom edge drawn in SVG; the content stays upright), splash (focus lines around a wide empty centre, title on a paper plate), beta (ink flat). interactive lifts it on hover; selected adds a double ink frame.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/card". It wraps your own components/ui/card, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A comic panel with a screentone shadow.
meta.usage:
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/card"

<Card variant="tilted">
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>Chapter 12</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardContent>The long night.</CardContent>
</Card>
